Correctly equating the two expressions for \(5/a_1\):

\[
q^2 - 2(1+q) = q^3 - 2(1+q+q^2)
\]

\[
q^2 - 2 - 2q = q^3 - 2 - 2q - 2q^2
\]

Cancel \(-2-2q\):

\[
q^2 = q^3 - 2q^2
\]

\[
q^3 - 3q^2 = 0
\]

\[
q^2(q-3)=0
\]

So \(q=0\) or \(q=3\). Since the common ratio of a geometric sequence is nonzero, \(q\neq 0\).

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
